corrected_blocks.text: אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים. אָהַבְתָּ אוֹתָנוּ וְרָצִיתָ בָּנוּ. וְרוֹמַמְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת. וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ. וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ. וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵינוּ קָרָאתָ:
changes: No change to the letters or punctuation. The printed periods after הָעַמִּים, בָּנוּ, הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת, בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ and לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ, and the colon after קָרָאתָ, all match the image.
Restored the opening from אַתָּה to מַלְכֵּנוּ, which the blind reading left out (it is in band 2, lines 6–7, and band 3, line 1).

changes: Changed וְאֶת־יוֹם inside the parentheses to וְאֶת יוֹם. The small-type ואת יום has no maqaf. The maqaf in the main-text אֶת־יוֹם is printed and kept.
The parenthesised words (הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְאֶת יוֹם), (זִכְרוֹן) and (בְּאַהֲבָה) are printed in smaller type. They are conditional (Shabbat) insertions within the prayer, not instructions.

corrected_blocks.text: וּמִפְּנֵי חֲטָאֵינוּ גָּלִינוּ מֵאַרְצֵנוּ וְנִתְרַחַקְנוּ מֵעַל אַדְמָתֵנוּ וְאֵין אֲנַחְנוּ יְכוֹלִים לַעֲשׂוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵינוּ בְּבֵית בְּחִירָתֶךָ בַּבַּיִת הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁנִּקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלָיו מִפְּנֵי הַיָּד שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּלְּחָה בְּמִקְדָּשֶׁךָ: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ רַחֲמָן שֶׁתָּשׁוּב וּתְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים וְתִבְנֵהוּ מְהֵרָה וּתְגַדֵּל כְּבוֹדוֹ:

corrected_blocks.text: Thou hast chosen us from all peoples, loved us and found delight in us and exalted us above all tongues and sanctified us through Thy commandments, and brought us near, O our King, to Thy service and proclaimed Thy great and holy Name unto us.

corrected_blocks.text: Thou hast given us, O Lord our God, in love this day (of the Sabbath and this day) of remembrance, a day (of remembrance) of Teruah (in love) for a sacred convocation, a reminder of the exodus from Egypt.
changes: Removed the comma the primary had after 'Lord'. The print reads 'O Lord our God,'.
'convoca-tion' is hyphenated at a line break in the print and joined here as 'convocation'.

corrected_blocks.text: Because of our sins we were exiled from our land and removed from our soil and we are unable to fulfil our duties in the House of Thy choice upon which Thy Name has been called, because of the hand that was stretched out against Thy sanctuary. May it be pleasing to Thee, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, O compassionate King, that Thou mayest again, in Thine abundant mercies, have compassion on us and on Thy sanctuary and rebuild it speedily and add to its glory. Our Father, our King, speedily reveal the glory of Thy Kingdom to us and appear and be exalted over us before the eyes
changes: Confirmed. 'King-dom' is joined. 'mayest' is printed with a broken final t, but the reading is clear. The text breaks off mid-sentence and continues on s255.
